summary_1line: Rama recounts how Budha, son of Soma, meets and unites with Ila in the forest, leading toward the birth of Pururavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a lonely mountain forest, Budha, son of the Moon, speaks tenderly to the beautiful Ila after the Kinnaris have departed.
Budha stands in a river performing penance with arms raised while Ila awakens nearby and gazes at him on the secluded mountain.
